messages:
jordan: Heads up — customer T-8421 opened a ticket about huge tail latency on embeddings after yesterday's config push. 95th/99th jumped ~3-5x. Happens intermittently, mostly during 10:00-11:30 UTC. Suspect batching behavior. Logs + repro below.

jordan: repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' \ 
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-3-large-quant","input":["short text"]}'
```

jordan: sample runtime log snippets (filtered):
```
[2026-02-14T10:12:05.123Z] batch_stats tenant=T-8421 shard=shard-3 queued_ms=220 batch_size=1 processed_ms=18
[2026-02-14T10:12:05.345Z] batch_stats tenant=T-8421 shard=shard-3 queued_ms=240 batch_size=1 processed_ms=20
[2026-02-14T10:12:06.007Z] batch_stats tenant=T-8421 shard=shard-3 queued_ms=310 batch_size=2 processed_ms=25
```

samir: Can you confirm current batching config for that tenant/model? I need max_batch_size, max_wait_ms, and whether dynamic_batching is on. Also which variant exactly (quant settings).

jordan: Model: text-embed-3-large-quant (q4_8bit). Tenant config shows dynamic_batching: true, max_batch_size: 128, max_wait_ms: 50 (global override applied last week).

lee: We rolled a small autoscaler + shard rebalancer yesterday at 00:47 UTC. That moved a few heavy users around — might have concentrated small requests onto shard-3. @ops-oncall can you dump per-shard metrics?

ops-oncall: Pasting quick metrics snapshot (10:12 UTC):
```
shard-1: avg_batch_size=28 avg_queue_len=2 throughput=420r/s
shard-2: avg_batch_size=22 avg_queue_len=3 throughput=380r/s
shard-3: avg_batch_size=1.9 avg_queue_len=18 throughput=60r/s
```

samir: That looks like a classic shard imbalance / batching starvation case. Shard-3 is getting many small, bursty single-request arrivals so dynamic batching isn't aggregating large batches. With max_batch_size so high we don't trigger the larger batch path and we spend time waiting at the queue boundary. Two quick mitigations: lower tenant max_batch_size to 64 and increase max_wait_ms to 100 for this model (gives more chance to coalesce). Also consider enabling short prefix-caching for identical small inputs.

jordan: I'll apply a patch to that tenant via the config API and test. Patch cmd (internal):
```
PATCH /v1/tenants/T-8421/config
{
  "models": {"text-embed-3-large-quant": {"dynamic_batching": true, "max_batch_size": 64, "max_wait_ms": 100}}
}
```

infra-bot: config-change applied to tenant T-8421 by jordan at 1738801200 :white_check_mark:

jordan: Results after change (10:30 UTC): 95th latency dropped from ~420ms -> ~130ms, 99th from ~780ms -> ~210ms. Customer reported perceived improvement. Still seeing rare spikes where shard-3 processes a string of single large requests; need follow-up on routing and shard affinity.

samir: Good improvement. As follow-up let's add a routing rule to spread small-request clients across shards (rate-based hashing) and add an autoscaler threshold for avg_batch_size < 5 to trigger rebalancing sooner. I'll open ENG-RUNTIME work item.

maria: Marking support ticket as mitigated and adding a short playbook entry: "embed-batching-shard-imbalance" with recommended quick fixes (lower max_batch_size, increase max_wait_ms, check shard avg_batch_size).

jordan: Closing the immediate customer escalation; leaving thread open for ENG action items. :eyes:
